Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to correctly extract and report the birth date from the Wikipedia page it successfully navigated to in Step 9. In Step 9, the agent opened the Wikipedia page for Charles Saunders (director), which clearly stated his birth date as "8 April 1924". However, in Step 10, when analyzing the results of a subsequent search, the agent reported conflicting data (citing TMDB's 1904 date) and failed to acknowledge or utilize the definitive 1924 date found in the previously accessed Wikipedia source. This led to an unresolved ambiguity regarding the director's birth year, preventing the final comparison from being made correctly.
